name: ActivityPub Mastodon API
description: Exposes a Mastodon-compatible REST API so mobile, desktop and web clients can interact with your Drupal ActivityPub server.
project_description: Submodule of the ActivityPub project. Implements a subset of the Mastodon client REST API (apps, oauth, accounts, timelines, statuses, notifications, media, search, instance, bookmarks, favourites, conversations, preferences) as core REST resource plugins, so standard Mastodon mobile/desktop/web clients can connect to a Drupal ActivityPub server. Authentication uses OAuth2 (Simple OAuth) via the ActivityPub API submodule.
